usage: Use 貓眼石 for the gemstone known in English as cat's eye; it is a countable noun in jewelry/gemstone contexts.
It often appears with words about accessories, such as 戒指, 項鍊, and 手鏈, when describing a stone set in jewelry.
This is a fairly specific, technical word, so it is more common in product descriptions, gem shops, and collecting contexts than in casual chat.
When talking about appearance, people may pair it with colour or quality words to describe the stone’s shine, pattern, or value.
